Subject: An Evening of Ideas - March 18

Hi,

The Music City Ideas Society invites your CEO to An Evening of Ideas on March 18, 2027 in Nashville, TN, for 250 members. Our board chair, Linda Moss, will open the evening and welcome guests. The fireside conversation itself will be led by podcast host Darius Cole.

Thank you,
Becca Hale
Executive Director, Music City Ideas Society
